problem: Coding agents often write old-style web code because their training data is full of legacy patterns. This project gives agents up-to-date web best-practice guides for developers using them.

stack.frontend: Evaluation dashboard served with Playwright tests (details not stated)
stack.backend: TypeScript on Node.js (22.18 or newer) with a CLI called gd, managed with pnpm
stack.ai: Skills for coding agents, a RAG-style guide search with benchmarks, and LLM graders and eval harnesses
stack.deploy: npm package run with npx (modern-web-guidance CLI), skills published for agents, and a dashboard on GitHub Pages

whatsNew: Instead of relying on what the model remembers, it retrieves short expert-written guides into the agent's context. Guides are pruned using evals so only content models do not already know is kept.
